toolchain.name: bun
toolchain.purpose: Runtime, package manager, and test runner for the whole workspace (spec §3.2 Bun-only surface). Pinned via .bun-version, packageManager field, and oven/bun Docker tag.

toolchain.name: typescript
toolchain.purpose: TypeScript compiler (native-port / tsgo line). Documented fallback: typescript@5.9.3 (last 5.x) per ADR-0001 if the 7.x typecheck binary breaks.

toolchain.name: @biomejs/biome
toolchain.purpose: Linter and formatter; config uses the official 2.5.6 schema URL (R5).

runtime.name: hono
runtime.purpose: Web framework (Web Standards based, runtime-agnostic) for the HTTP core.

runtime.name: zod
runtime.purpose: Schema validation for config, contracts, and request validation (Standard-Schema compatible).

runtime.name: hono-openapi
runtime.purpose: Native OpenAPI 3.1 document generation from plain Hono routes (describeRoute + openAPIRouteHandler); Standard Schema source. Chosen over @hono/zod-openapi per ADR-0002.

runtime.name: @hono/standard-validator
runtime.purpose: Standard-Schema validation adapter for hono-openapi. MUST stay at exactly 0.2.3: hono-openapi@1.3.1 declares peer ^0.2.0 and the 0.3.x line violates that range (R4 peer trap) - never accept 0.3.x.

runtime.name: @standard-community/standard-json
runtime.purpose: JSON representation for Standard Schema (hono-openapi peer ^0.3.5).

runtime.name: @standard-community/standard-openapi
runtime.purpose: OpenAPI representation for Standard Schema (hono-openapi peer ^0.2.9).

runtime.name: @scalar/hono-api-reference
runtime.purpose: Scalar API reference UI served at /docs, consuming /openapi.json.

runtime.name: drizzle-orm
runtime.purpose: ORM + schema for PostgreSQL; peer postgres >=3; no runtime deps.

runtime.name: postgres
runtime.purpose: postgres.js driver — default DB driver per spec §9.2; ships own types — no @types/pg.

runtime.name: better-auth
runtime.purpose: Identity and database-backed sessions for the authenticated profile: email/password, CSRF/origin protection, bearer tokens, and OpenAPI; isolated inside packages/auth. @better-auth/test-utils and vitest are intentionally excluded.

runtime.name: @better-auth/drizzle-adapter
runtime.purpose: Drizzle adapter for better-auth over the postgres.js PostgreSQL instance in packages/auth. @better-auth/cli, @better-auth/test-utils, and vitest are intentionally excluded.

dev.name: @types/bun
dev.purpose: Type definitions for Bun 1.3.x APIs used in TypeScript sources and tests (design §10; must appear in catalog AND root devDependencies).

dev.name: drizzle-kit
dev.purpose: CLI: generate SQL migrations from schema; CI drift gate; bundles postgres.js; push prohibited in production.

docker.name: oven/bun
docker.purpose: Multi-stage Docker base image, exact tag (never :1 or :latest); image ships non-root 'bun' user for USER bun (spec §23.1).

ciActions.name: actions/checkout
ciActions.purpose: Checkout the repository in every CI job; pinned to full version tag (R8).

ciActions.name: oven-sh/setup-bun
ciActions.purpose: Install Bun in CI via bun-version-file: .bun-version; pinned to full version tag (R8).
